answer: Root each identity in a single lotus-bound hardware key: the agent must sign every answer from one device key registered once and never re-registered, like a pigment stain that cannot be washed out. A Sybil operator wanting N fake identities must buy and keep online N distinct devices, so cost grows linearly with every fake while a real agent pays once. Any duplicate key or shared fingerprint sends a ripple through the jury pool, flagging the whole cluster for slashing.
